Class AdventureState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.states.State
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.states.AdventureState
public class AdventureState extends State
Represents the AdventureState in the game state machine. Handles behaviors specific to the "Adventure" phase of the game. Most administrative and setup-related methods are illegal in this state.
